title: SharePoint: tenant-wide usage statistics for SharePoint agents
summary: The briefing cannot substantiate its assurance that no administrator action is needed, and that assurance conflicts with its stated unknown default. The roadmap details and existing Agent Insights control are accurate, but the documentation gap must distinguish this roadmap item from the agent usage and access reports Microsoft already documents.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to aggregate SharePoint agent usage statistics across all SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

claims.where: summary; front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: No admin action is needed for the reporting feature.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint agent usage statistics no action' and 'SharePoint tenant statistics agent rollout'; opened Monitor agent usage, Insights report on agents, Monitor agent access, and Microsoft Copilot Agents usage report. None states this for the roadmap item.
claims.fix: Replace 'no admin action is needed' with 'Microsoft has not stated what happens on arrival'. This also resolves the internal conflict with defaultState: unknown and the same statement in Why it matters. Do not infer automatic availability or an absence of setup requirements.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page describes the tenant-wide SharePoint agent usage statistics feature yet.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint agent usage report statistics', 'SharePoint usage statistics agents licensing', and 'SharePoint 480729'; opened Monitor agent access and Microsoft Copilot Agents usage report. Both document relevant analytics, but neither identifies this roadmap item.
claims.fix: Replace the blanket documentation-gap statement and 'Until a Learn page exists' with 'Microsoft documents agent access across SharePoint and OneDrive sites and SharePoint agent usage in Copilot, but the sources checked do not explicitly identify either report as roadmap item 480729.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/insights-on-agent-access and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/microsoft-365-copilot-agents-new?view=o365-worldwide. Do not assert that either report implements this item.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify where the statistics will appear.
claims.quote: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify which measures the statistics include.
claims.quote: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify the statistics' refresh frequency.
claims.quote: SharePoint agents' usage statistics would be aggregated across all SharePoint sites and available for the tenant admin persona.

claims.claim: Learn says Microsoft is prioritising richer analytics across the Copilot Analytics dashboard, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, SharePoint Advanced Management and SharePoint Online in the coming months.
claims.quote: Microsoft is prioritizing delivering even richer analytics across Copilot Analytics dashboard, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, SharePoint Advanced Management, and SharePoint Online in the coming months.

claims.claim: The existing Agent Insights report covers recently created agents across all SharePoint and OneDrive sites in the organisation.
claims.quote: The insights report on agents in SharePoint provides SharePoint administrators with rich information on the recently created agents across all SharePoint sites and OneDrive sites within their organization.

claims.claim: The existing report is built from audit data on agent file creation and renaming.
claims.quote: The insights report is based on the Microsoft audit data logged for the agents created in SharePoint through the FileCreated and FileRenamed events.

claims.claim: The existing creation report describes agent inventory rather than how often agents are used.
claims.quote: SharePoint admins can use SharePoint Online Management Shell to get an inventory of the agents created across sites at the organization level in a specified time period.

claims.claim: The existing report is reached at SharePoint admin center > Reports > Agent Insights.
claims.quote: Sign in to the SharePoint admin center with the SharePoint administrator credentials for your organization. In the navigation pane, expand Reports and then select Agent Insights.

claims.claim: Start-SPOCopilotAgentInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays 28 generates the existing report for the past 28 days in SharePoint Online Management Shell.
claims.quote: To generate a report for any other duration (7, 14, or 28 days) ... Start-SPOCopilotAgentInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays ... For example, to generate a report for the past 28 days ... Start-SPOCopilotAgentInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays <28>

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance

claims.claim: SharePoint agent usage can incur pay-as-you-go charges that appear under the Copilot Studio meter on the invoice.
claims.quote: Charges of SharePoint agent usage appear under the Copilot Studio meter in your invoice. However, in Microsoft cost management, you can see a detailed breakdown by feature, including SharePoint agents.

claims.claim: The checklist's instruction to check data collection has a corresponding controls row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'whether data collection is enabled'. The sole row governs 'Agent Insights report on agents across SharePoint and OneDrive sites' and scripts report generation, not data collection.
claims.fix: Remove 'and whether data collection is enabled' from the first Before rollout bullet; the data-collection control has no row. Do not add a row as part of this correction.

claims.fix: Remove the second Before rollout bullet; neither pay-as-you-go billing nor the Cost Management budget has a controls row. Do not add rows as part of this correction.
